## Purpose
The code-requirement orchestration package. It decides whether code needs building and writes the specification it is generated from and tested against. The tool service decides how to build it and proves that it works.

## Responsibilities
- The docstring maps the modules:
  - `profiles` decides tool vs activity;
  - `layers` holds R1–R8;
  - `preflight` holds the deterministic checks (R6);
  - `smoke` holds the post-build check and rollback (R7b);
  - `pipeline` holds the entry points.
- It re-exports `resolve_code_need` and `resolve_code_needs`.

## Key elements
`__all__ = ["resolve_code_need", "resolve_code_needs"]`.
